sources.author: De-Vanced
patch_list: Enable DCIM folders backup control
Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing you to control backup for each folder individually. This will make the app default to having no folders backed up.
Fix selected account persistence
Prevents Google Photos from clearing the selected account after cold start when using MicroG.
GmsCore support
Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.
Spoof features
Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.

sources.label: Morphe Patches for Google Photos and Android Apps
sources.author: Morphe Google Photos
patch_list: AMOLED dark theme
Makes Google Photos dark surfaces true black while keeping light mode untouched.
Custom Morphe branding
Replaces the Google Photos icon and in-app logos with Morphe branding (violet / teal / indigo / slate pinwheel, hand-drawn style).
DCIM & backup control
Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing individual folder control, and exports memory collages and creations to DCIM/Google Photos for quota-free backup.
Flag manager & Toolkit
Enables an in-app flag manager and Morphe toolkit in Photos Settings to toggle experimental UI redesigns, video editor tools, and feature flags.
GmsCore support
Enables GmsCore / MicroG support and renames package for non-root installs. Leave enabled for standard non-root installs; disable only for rooted system installs using genuine Google Play Services.
Media engine & AI fixes
Bypasses the 0MB Mobile Data Download check for AI models and fixes font loading across Stories and UI to prevent blank text and fallback fonts.
Official package name

Spoof features
Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.
